en-US.description: Powerful yet simple to use screenshot software.
en-US.name: Flameshot
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed

New Features
- Let the GUI colors be choosen via hex values by @IndolikarQuantifier in #4738
- Add arrow style selector by @serebryakov02 in #4769
- Increment/decrement circle counter on mouse wheel by @milnadar in #4698
- Add keyboard controls to monitor selector by @serebryakov02 in #4811
- Fall back to native X11 capture when the portal is unavailable by @jmcarthur in #4827
- Add option to disable the Circle Counter outline by @bekirsoylu in #4882
- Removed the close on double click on pinned captures and moved it to shortcut which is configurable through config by @IndolikarQuantifier in #4993
- add more desktop terminal emulators to TerminalLauncher by @anushTikoo in #5010
- Make the UI language picker a filterable search box by @nicitaacom in #4891
- __KOMAC_HEADER__ Bug Fixes
- Fix capture when logical min/max coordinates are not zero by @rs-pro0 in #4735
- Fixing the currently broken macOS packaging for x64 (Intel) by @HackintoshHD in #4795
- Commit text on Esc in text tool by @serebryakov02 in #4804
- Fix screen capture ignoring GUI last-region setting by @serebryakov02 in #4789
- Fix aspect ratio in selection widget when pressing CTRL by @ElTh0r0 in #4651
- Fail fast when the screenshot portal cannot take the capture by @jmcarthur in #4826
- Fix monitor selector stuck after closing via window manager by @renathossain in #4839
- Fix issue in winows cli by @borgmanJeremy in #4881
- Improve windows-cli by @ElTh0r0 in #4888
- Fix pin size on Windows for scaled screen by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in #4907
- Fall back to a same-language translation for unmatched locales by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in #4932
- Use the installed binary path in the desktop entry actions by @Dev-next-gen in #4950
- workaround to reposition window on Mate X11 by @borgmanJeremy in #4946
- Persist tool size when it changes, not when the notifier hides by @bterps in #4961
- fix(macos): bundle translations inside the app by @fmendezy in #4986
- utils: Add missing iterator in strfparse by @aokblast in #5012
- Update save dialog file suffix when the format filter changes by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in #4931
- Refresh launcher region inputs after each capture by @lev-spassky in #5004
- fix(macos): publish clipboard captures as public.png/public.jpeg by @fmendezy in #4985
